answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a scarce bonded stake whose history is hashed into a public registry, much as ivory marker sealed beneath a raven-dark ablation layer on a re-entry reef shield. Colluders who clone identities must post independent collateral per pseudonym, so the marginal cost scales with every forged key rather than amortizing. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
